pipeline: Relic Maker (Hunyuan3D shapes + textures projected from Timothy Holt's paintings)
instructions: Each sacred hero relic is modeled from Timothy Holt's paintings with the Relic Maker (Hunyuan3D shapes + textures projected from the paintings). Export as .glb and save into assets/models/<id>.glb, or use Test .glb File Live below to hot-swap any .glb directly into the 3D world with the warm oil-on-linen shader.
